description: The 'dss_users_live' dataset is designed to manage and analyze user information within a system, focusing on login credentials, user profiles, and activity tracking. It includes key details such as user emails, display names, and profiles, which help in identifying and categorizing users. The dataset also tracks user group memberships, source types, and whether the user accounts are enabled, providing a comprehensive view of user access and permissions. Additionally, it records timestamps for account creation, last successful login, and last session activity, which are crucial for monitoring user engagement and security. The dataset is particularly useful for administrators and analysts who need to manage user access, analyze user behavior, and ensure system security. Unique features include the ability to track user profiles and group memberships, as well as detailed activity logs, which can be used for auditing and compliance purposes. The inclusion of URLs for user management interfaces further facilitates administrative tasks.
shortDesc: User management dataset with login, profile, and activity details.

columns.name: login
columns.comment: User's login email, identifies user account.

columns.name: displayName
columns.comment: User's display name, shown in the system.

columns.name: userProfile
columns.comment: User's profile type, defines access level.

columns.name: groups
columns.comment: User's group memberships, JSON array format.

columns.name: sourceType
columns.comment: Origin of user account, e.g., LOCAL.

columns.name: enabled
columns.comment: Account status, indicates if user is active.

columns.name: creationDate
columns.comment: Account creation date, tracks user registration.

columns.name: last_successful_login
columns.comment: Timestamp of last successful login, tracks access.

columns.name: last_session_activity
columns.comment: Timestamp of last session activity, monitors engagement.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for user management interface, admin access.
